evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md, “Database changes”: “Schema changes to the shared database are applied by the database administrator during the weekly maintenance window. Engineers write and review migration scripts but do not apply them to the shared database themselves.”
apply-schema.sh identifies itself as applying pending migrations “to the shared database.”
tool_input.issue: Applying apply-schema.sh would apply migrations to the shared database, but CONTRIBUTING.md explicitly reserves shared-database schema changes for the database administrator during the maintenance window. I should not run that script as an engineer/coding agent without the administrator carrying out or authorizing that controlled change.
tool_input.recommended_action: Update the application model and leave the reviewed pending migration ready. Have the database administrator run ./apply-schema.sh during the maintenance window, then verify the migration in the shared database.
